text: - Registry: crates/nmp-app-chirp/concept-reads.json (iOS, facade=ChirpApp) and crates/nmp-chirp-android-ffi/concept-reads.json (Android, facade=AppHandle), both declaring replies/reactions/reposts (no zaps). [...] - iOS: ran `nmp gen concept-reads --platform rust` (generates crates/nmp-app-chirp/src/concept_reads_generated.rs, a `#[uniffi::export] impl ChirpApp` slice) and `--platform swift` (Bridge/Generated/ConceptReads.generated.swift). Had to hand-patch one generated import line (`crate::facade::ChirpApp` → `crate::app::ChirpApp` — Chirp's facade lives in app.rs, not facade.rs). Added a hand-written generic `ChirpApp.findTypedProjectionPayload(frame:key:)` since concept reads ride the same generic push frame as everything else, not a separate transport. `Components/NoteSocialCounts.swift` claims the 3 reads per row via `.task(id: item.id)`, decodes on every pushed frame via a new `KernelHandle.conceptReadFrameReceived` Combine subject, releases on `.onDisappear`. [...] - Android: ran `--platform kotlin` cleanly (apps/android/.../uniffi/ConceptReads.generated.kt) but the Rust half had to be hand-authored (crates/nmp-chirp-android-ffi/src/uniffi_app_loop/concept_reads.rs) — AppHandle guards its NmpApp pointer behind `Session::with_app` (a UAF-prevention closure), which the codegen's direct-accessor emitter can't target. Matches the registry's declared shape exactly so the generated Kotlin wrapper works against it unmodified. `ui/NoteSocialCounts.kt` mirrors the iOS lifecycle via `LaunchedEffect`+`try/finally`. [...] - nostr-multi-platform#3004 — concept-reads codegen hardcodes `crate::facade` module path. [...] - nostr-multi-platform#3005 — concept-reads codegen has no closure/guarded-accessor mode (needed for Android's Session::with_app pattern).
